title: Faryaad
body:
zulm kya kya na huwe mere nabi aap ke baad
chain se aale nabi reh na saki aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
zul asheera ke lage zakhm saqeefa mein khule
saamne aagaye nasoor e khafi aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
tera mimbar teri mehrab gawahi denge
sayyeda bar sare darbar gayi aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
qabre zahra pe faqad zabt ka daama choota
roye bas ek dafa maula ali aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon jiska tha tera khoon badan tera badan
khoon mein hai ghark wohi farqe ali aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
raakib e doshe nabuwwat wo tere shaahzade
haif unse hui bayyat talabi aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
teer yun barse janaze pe hassan ke nana
usko pehlu mein zameen mil na saki aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
haal kaise ho bayan sibte nabi ka aaqa
kaat kar legaya sar ek shaqi aap ke baad
<<DIVIDER>>
aale athaar se phirne ka nateeja hai raza
hurmate ummate aasi na rahi aap ke baad
author: Hasan Raza Rizvi
